summary: ENB Financial Corp filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.18 per share for the third quarter, consistent with prior quarters. The dividend is payable September 15, 2026 to holders of record August 14, 2026. The filing attaches a press release as Exhibit 99. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation such as a special dividend, capital return, restructuring, or other event-driven corporate action. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, liquidation, delisting, or deal termination is involved.
